groups.label: Injected receipt failure rolls back every derived package, identity, source and revision row; original pixels remain unchanged
groups.failurePoint: Post-package creation, before spatial_ml_footprint_drafts receipt insertion, injected by an isolated PostgreSQL trigger
groups.rollbackAssertion: Every listed table returns to its exact pre-request row count; the ML item retains zero footprint-draft links

groups.label: Retry creates one linked draft and receipt atomically; actual derived original bytes survive commit and replay
assertions: Retry of the failed request succeeds and links the new package from the ML item
Same-key replay returns that package and leaves exactly one footprint receipt
The draft retains the original image source revision and cloned document-part linkage
Derived semantics remain unresolved and exterior height remains unknown
No physical feature is published and the source preparation revision is unchanged
The derived S3 source bytes remain readable after commit and match their persisted SHA-256

environment.database: Real PostgreSQL/PostGIS in a unique test-owned schema, dropped after the run
environment.storage: Real local S3-compatible storage; cleanup is restricted to tracked objects created by this test

qualification: Inference output is explicitly synthetic; this test is transaction and source-preservation evidence, not a model-accuracy or actual-inference benchmark
Original and derived object readback hashes are checked against real stored bytes
Unreferenced newly derived S3 bytes may be retained after database rollback; no original object is altered or deleted by the handoff
TypeScript checking and the focused diff check also passed; final production build is recorded separately
